change_summary: Changed grid in kernel_function() from static tuple `(triton.cdiv(xnumel, 1),)` to dynamic lambda `lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, meta['XBLOCK']),)` so the grid size correctly scales with the autotuned XBLOCK value, enabling larger XBLOCK configs (16, 32) to reduce the grid from 2048 to 128/64 blocks and eliminate the 33.3% partial-wave tail overhead.
